name: Live announcements
description: The line across every page: every announcement not disabled and not past its end, newest first, with whether a reader may dismiss it. Dismissing is the browser's, per reader; Soma keeps no per-reader state. season_cache on the announcements namespace: a publish or a disable invalidates it in the same run, and an ending is a time, so an ended one lingers until the next miss or the TTL, at most ten minutes.
